# Kyle Parker Cunningham

> American artist, born 1983 in Wyoming and raised in Montana, who paints, makes prints and sculpts in Truth or Consequences, New Mexico, and makes films. This site shows his work; the complete catalogue of every work is the archive at archive.kyleparkercunningham.com.

Pages carry schema.org structured data. Each work page states its title, year, medium and size. Text on this site is Kyle's own unless it says otherwise; /manifest/ lists who wrote each page.

## The work

- [The archive](https://archive.kyleparkercunningham.com): the catalogue of record, every work with its full details, and a public API at /api/v1/works
- [Oeuvre](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/oeuvre/): every work on this site, by year
- [Painting](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/oeuvre/painting/)
- [Printmaking](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/oeuvre/printmaking/)
- [Projects](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/projects/): groups of works and the ideas behind them
- [Cinema](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/cinema/): the films

## About

- [Artist statement](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/artist-statement/)
- [Collect](https://kyleparkercunningham.com/collect/): how to see or acquire the work
